title: forge parse data
description: Payload of `forge parse --json`: the parsed AST, or the parse diagnostic when the file does not parse. See `forge schema` for the envelope this fills.

file.description: Source path as given on the command line.

ast.description: The AST as its `{:#?}` debug tree — the AST derives Debug, not Serialize, so this is the same text human mode prints.

diagnostics.description: The single parse failure that stopped the command.
